Rejects an unknown external finding offset encoding

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Xberg\Xberg;
use Xberg\ExternalRedactionFinding;
use Xberg\ExtractInput;
use Xberg\RedactionFinding;
$input = \Xberg\ExtractInput::from_json(json_encode(["bytes" => [90, 97, 114, 110, 97, 107], "filename" => "external-findings-invalid.txt", "kind" => "bytes", "mimeType" => "text/plain"]));
try {
    Xberg::extractWithExternalRedaction($input, [], [ExternalRedactionFinding::from_json('{"label":"inspection_person","score":0.99,"text":"Zarnak"}')], "bytes-ish", 8);
} catch (Throwable $error) {
    echo $error::class . ': ' . $error->getMessage() . "\n";
}
```
